name: stability ball front plank
description: A forearm plank with your elbows on a stability ball. The wobbly surface makes your abs and shoulders work harder to hold a straight line.
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral and your hips from sagging or rising.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower to the floor.
